glosses: A lid.
Area or situation which screens a person or thing from view.

examples.text: The soldiers took cover behind a ruined building.

glosses: A tarpaulin or other device used to cover the wicket during rain, to prevent it getting wet.

glosses: A collection (or family) of subsets of a given set, whose union contains every element of said original set.

glosses: An envelope complete with stamps and postmarks etc.
